messages:
claire: opened a PR to fix the /files docs. examples mixed multipart/form-data and JSON inconsistently; OpenAPI currently declares `attachments` as an object but runtime expects an array. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/620
ryan: saw it. our Java SDK users hit a 400 because the sample showed a map for attachments instead of an array. can we surface both multipart and JSON batch examples and call out which clients prefer which path?
claire: yes. adding both. also adding an SSE progress example for large uploads and a short troubleshooting checklist. multipart curl example:
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.com/v1/files -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" -F "file=@file.pdf" -F "metadata={\"title\":\"report\"};type=application/json"
```
claire: JSON batch curl example:
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.com/v1/files -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"attachments":[{"filename":"file.pdf","content_base64":"..."}],"metadata":{"title":"report"}}'
```
mia: added a Java okhttp snippet showing MultipartBody.Builder and a note that attachments must be an array in the OpenAPI. also added a Python requests example using `files=` and `json=` examples so typed clients understand both shapes.
docs-bot: PR opened by claire (docs) - "files: multipart + json examples, OpenAPI attachments array, SSE upload progress sample" - CI: pending
julio: small nit: response examples in the doc used snake_case like `file_id` but API returns camelCase `fileId`. standardized to camelCase and added a migration note: clients will accept file_id for 14 days.
claire: updated response examples to camelCase and added a tiny Go snippet that tolerantly maps fileId/file_id when decoding. also added the upload troubleshooting checklist: auth, Content-Type, size limit, chunking.
ryan: CI docs build passed for the PR. the SSE example uses `Accept: text/event-stream` which is good; can we also include a short note about connection timeouts and server-sent event reconnections?
claire: added reconnect guidance and a link to the Console upload inspector for debugging. CI green. ready to merge unless anyone objects.
mia: :thumbsup:
